BL-965 — BL-960's heal wrapper leaks its mktemp capture file when the command is killed - no trap installs cleanup, and kills are routine (Bash-tool timeouts, respawn-pane -k, swarm teardown)
What it solves: 1:1 - the hardender's note produced this ticket and no other. depends_on: [BL-960] because the mktemp line this ticket fixes exists only on BL-960's parcel, not on main - this ticket cannot start until that lands (and the BL-957 gate, once live, enforces exactly that). Recorded on epic tracker BL-9…
Approval context: Nothing controversial: trap-based cleanup on catchable signals, SIGKILL residue acknowledged as unavoidable and left to the existing recognizable name pattern, no sweeper built. The one judgement call is severity medium (real leak, but inert until the hook re-enables and bounded by OS TMPDIR reapin…
BL-965 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-965" (or "reject BL-965 <reason>") to act.
